summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new Study Plan syllabus/timetable upload feature. All 6 scenarios in the review request passed: (1) login+course+plan-tab+new-plan dialog works; (2) syllabus .txt upload -> filename chip 'syllabus.txt' appears and Syllabus textarea (plan-syllabus) auto-fills with AI-extracted topics (~2s, 261 chars); (3) timetable .txt upload -> filename chip 'timetable.txt' appears and Timetable textarea (plan-timetable) auto-fills with AI busy/free summary (~3s, 354 chars); (4) both textareas remained editable after AI fill; (5) Generate produced a 5-day plan (plan-day-0..4) reflecting uploaded syllabus (Week1 Cells, Week2 Membranes, Week3 DNA, Week4 Protein Synthesis, Day5 Revision) - toast 'Study plan created!' shown; (6) regression: plan can still be deleted; and plan can still be generated by typing topics manually without uploading any file (manual regression PASS).

issues: Dialog missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'). Minor a11y issue only.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Build-a-study-plan DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CourseView.js is 942 lines and holds many tabs/subcomponents (PlanTab, ScheduleUpload, etc.). Consider splitting per-tab into separate files (>700-line guideline).

uploadSchedule() sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data manually - most axios setups let the browser set the correct boundary automatically; harmless here since it works, but usually cleaner to omit the header for FormData.
In ScheduleUpload the file input has `hidden` attribute - Playwright still handled it via set_input_files, but `hidden` inputs are not visible; this is intentional and fine.
Toasts render correctly ('Syllabus read by AI', 'Timetable read by AI', 'Study plan created!').
seed_data_creation: Created a fresh course 'Biology 101 Test' under admin; created two study plans (uploaded & manual) - manual plan left in DB (safe to delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Syllabus/Timetable upload works end-to-end. AI extraction is fast (~2-3s for .txt). data-testids used: new-plan-btn, upload-syllabus-btn/-input, upload-timetable-btn/-input, plan-syllabus, plan-timetable, plan-exam-name, plan-exam-date, plan-hours, plan-topics, create-plan-submit, plan-<id>, plan-day-<i>.
